products.name: Debt Financing for Middle Market Companies
products.description: Origination, structuring, and investment in secured and unsecured term loans, mezzanine debt, and bonds primarily for privately-held middle market companies. These are physical financial products requiring significant capital, underwriting, and ongoing monitoring, and are delivered through direct lending and syndication.

products.name: Investment in Collateralized Loan Obligation (CLO) Fund Securities
products.description: Minority investments in subordinated securities or preferred stock of CLO funds managed by third-party asset managers. These are financial instruments purchased and held as part of a diversified investment portfolio, requiring financial capital and due diligence.

products.name: Equity Investments and Warrants in Middle Market Companies
products.description: Equity investments and receipt of warrants or options to purchase common stock in privately held middle market companies, often in connection with debt investments. These are financial products requiring capital and are typically structured as part of broader financing solutions.

products.name: Joint Venture Investments in Loan Funds
products.description: Investments in joint ventures that underwrite and hold senior, secured unitranche loans to middle-market companies. These are financial investments made through structured partnerships with other financial institutions, requiring capital and ongoing oversight.

products.name: Advanced Safety and User Experience Solutions
products.description: Integrated hardware and software solutions for vehicles, including intelligent sensors, high-performance compute platforms, and advanced software tools and services. These products are physically manufactured and digitally developed, supporting features such as advanced driver assistance systems, in-cabin infotainment, driver interface, and interior sensing.

products.name: Engineered Connection and Protection Components
products.description: Manufactured connection systems, high-performance interconnects, and cable management and protection solutions that optimize the distribution of power, signal, and data for next-generation applications across automotive, aerospace, telecom, and industrial markets. These are physical components produced in global manufacturing facilities.

products.name: Electrical Distribution Systems
products.description: Comprehensive low voltage and high voltage power, signal, and data distribution solutions for vehicles and other applications, including fully integrated, cost-optimized electrical architectures. These are physically manufactured wiring and distribution systems supplied to OEMs and other industries.

products.name: OpRegen Allogeneic Retinal Pigment Epithelial (RPE) Cell Therapy
products.description: A cell replacement therapy consisting of allogeneic, mature retinal pigment epithelial cells manufactured from pluripotent stem cells, delivered via subretinal injection to treat geographic atrophy secondary to dry age-related macular degeneration. Produced using proprietary cGMP processes and a thaw-and-inject formulation for immediate use.

products.name: OPC1 Allogeneic Oligodendrocyte Progenitor Cell Therapy
products.description: A cell therapy product composed of allogeneic oligodendrocyte progenitor cells derived from pluripotent stem cells, administered via direct injection into the spinal cord to promote remyelination and tissue repair in patients with spinal cord injury. Manufactured under cGMP conditions with a ready-to-use thaw-and-inject formulation.

products.name: ReSonance (ANP1) Allogeneic Auditory Neuron Progenitor Cell Therapy
products.description: A preclinical cell transplant therapy consisting of allogeneic auditory neuron progenitor cells derived from pluripotent stem cells, intended for transplantation to treat sensorineural hearing loss. Developed using proprietary differentiation and scalable manufacturing processes.

products.name: Islet Cell Transplant Therapy for Type 1 Diabetes (T1D)
products.description: A research-stage cell therapy initiative focused on large-scale production of undifferentiated pluripotent cells and their differentiation into islet cells for transplantation as a potential functional cure for Type 1 Diabetes. Utilizes proprietary scalable manufacturing technology to address commercial viability.

products.name: PNC1 Allogeneic Photoreceptor Cell Therapy
products.description: A research-stage cell therapy program developing allogeneic photoreceptor precursor cells from pluripotent stem cells for transplantation to treat vision loss due to photoreceptor degeneration, such as in retinitis pigmentosa. Manufactured using proprietary differentiation and cGMP processes.

products.name: RND1 Hypoimmune iPSC-derived Cell Therapy
products.description: A research-stage program developing cell transplant candidates from a novel hypoimmune induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) line, incorporating gene edits to reduce immunogenicity, for potential treatment of central nervous system diseases and other indications. Developed in partnership with gene editing technology providers.

products.name: Crude Oil
products.description: Crude oil is extracted from company-operated and non-operated wells in the U.S. Mid-Continent, primarily through drilling and production activities. The product is physically produced, gathered, and sold to oil and natural gas companies and trading and energy marketing companies.

products.name: Natural Gas
products.description: Natural gas is produced from wells operated or owned by the company in the Mid-Continent region. It is physically extracted, processed, and sold to external customers, including energy companies and marketers.

products.name: Natural Gas Liquids (NGLs)
products.description: NGLs are recovered through further processing of a portion of the company's natural gas production stream. The extraction and sale of NGLs involves processing natural gas to separate liquids, which are then sold by the gallon or barrel to external customers.

products.name: Enriched Isotopes for Industrial and Medical Applications
products.description: Production and commercialization of high-value, low-volume enriched isotopes (such as Carbon-14, Silicon-28, Ytterbium-176, Molybdenum-100, and others) using proprietary ASP and QE enrichment technologies. These isotopes are manufactured at dedicated enrichment facilities and supplied for use in nuclear medicine, pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, semiconductors, and advanced technology sectors.

products.name: Advanced Nuclear Fuels (including HALEU and Lithium-6)
products.description: Development and commercialization of advanced nuclear fuels, including High-Assay Low-Enriched Uranium (HALEU) and high-isotopic purity Lithium-6, using proprietary enrichment technologies. These fuels are produced at specialized enrichment facilities and supplied for use in next-generation nuclear reactors and fusion systems.

products.name: Radiopharmaceuticals and Radiopharmacy Services
products.description: Production and distribution of radiopharmaceuticals and fluorinated radioisotopes for nuclear medicine imaging and therapy, primarily through PET Labs and East Coast Nuclear Pharmacy. This includes in-house manufacturing of active pharmaceutical ingredients and downstream radiopharmacy operations, delivered to hospitals and clinics.

products.name: Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG)
products.description: Production and sale of liquefied natural gas (LNG) from onshore natural gas reserves, processed and liquefied at the Virginia Gas Project facility in South Africa. LNG is delivered to domestic customers as a lower-carbon energy source.

products.name: Liquid Helium
products.description: Production and sale of 99.999% pure liquid helium, separated and liquefied from natural gas at the Virginia Gas Project. Helium is supplied to global customers for use in semiconductors, medical imaging, scientific research, and other industries.

products.name: Public Civil Engineering and Construction Services
products.description: Provision of public civil engineering and construction services, including road and drainage works, footway, duct, and pipeline construction, primarily in Hong Kong. Services are delivered as both main contractor and subcontractor through Skyline and its subsidiaries.

products.name: Revenue Management and Digital Monetization Platforms
products.description: Cloud-based and on-premise SaaS platforms that provide real-time revenue management, billing, and digital monetization for companies with recurring customer relationships. These platforms streamline the entire commerce lifecycle from concept to cash and are delivered via public cloud, private cloud, or on-premise deployments.

products.name: Customer Experience and Engagement Solutions
products.description: SaaS platforms leveraging AI and analytics to deliver personalized, predictive, and proactive customer experiences across digital channels. These solutions include journey orchestration, customer analytics, and engagement tools to help businesses retain and grow customer relationships.

products.name: Payments Platform
products.description: End-to-end SaaS payments platform enabling organizations to accept electronic check/ACH, debit and credit card payments, and same-day ACH. The platform integrates with existing architectures, supports merchant onboarding, and includes advanced fraud prevention and compliance features.

products.name: Professional Services
products.description: Consulting, solution architecture, project management, systems implementation, system integration, and business consultancy services provided globally to support deployment and optimization of CSG’s technology solutions.

products.name: Operational Services (Managed Services)
products.description: Operational services including infrastructure management, application configuration management, and business operations management, delivered as managed services to help customers scale and focus on their core business.

products.name: Proteograph Product Suite
products.description: An integrated platform for deep, unbiased proteomic analysis, consisting of proprietary nanoparticle-based consumable assays, an automation instrument (SP200), and cloud-based data analysis software. The suite enables high-throughput, scalable, and precise proteome characterization from various biological samples using mass spectrometry, and is delivered as a combination of physical consumables, hardware, and digital analytics tools.

products.name: Proteograph Consumable Assays
products.description: Proprietary engineered nanoparticle-based consumables and reagents designed for unbiased, reproducible sampling of intact proteins from biological samples, enabling peptide-level resolution for mass spectrometry-based proteomics. These are physical products used in conjunction with the automation instrument and are sold as kits for research use.

products.name: Proteograph Automation Instrument (SP200)
products.description: A custom-configured, automated liquid handling workstation that executes the Proteograph workflow, enabling high-throughput, parallel sample processing for proteomic studies. The instrument is manufactured by a third party and is provided to customers as part of the Proteograph Product Suite, either for purchase or loan.

products.name: Proteograph Analysis Suite (PAS) Software
products.description: A cloud-based data analytics software suite that supports quality control, data management, and interpretation of Proteograph output, including proteogenomics workflows and interactive visualizations. Delivered digitally, it integrates proprietary and public MS data analysis tools for customers using the Proteograph platform.

products.name: Proteomics Data Generation Services (STAC and Service Providers)
products.description: Fee-for-service access to the Proteograph workflow and associated mass spectrometry analysis, provided through Seer Technology Access Centers (STAC) and partnered service providers. Customers submit samples and receive high-resolution proteomic data, enabling access without purchasing the full platform.

products.name: Oil and Natural Gas Production and Sales
products.description: The Trust receives 80% of the net proceeds from the sale of oil and natural gas produced from the Underlying Properties in Kansas and Texas. The oil and gas are physically extracted from wells operated by third parties, transported, and sold to third-party purchasers under market-based contracts. This is a physical commodity business requiring regulated infrastructure and in-person labor for extraction and delivery.

products.name: Chlor Alkali Products and Vinyls
products.description: Manufacture and sale of chlorine, caustic soda, ethylene dichloride (EDC), vinyl chloride monomer (VCM), chlorinated organics (including methyl chloride, methylene chloride, chloroform, carbon tetrachloride, perchloroethylene), hydrochloric acid, sodium hypochlorite (bleach), potassium hydroxide, and hydrogen. These are produced in large-scale, capital-intensive chemical plants and delivered via pipeline, marine vessel, barge, railcar, and truck to industrial customers globally.

products.name: Epoxy Materials and Precursors
products.description: Production and sale of epoxy resins (liquid and solid), formulated epoxy solutions, curing agents, and chemical intermediates such as allyl chloride, epichlorohydrin, acetone, and phenol. These are manufactured in integrated chemical facilities and supplied to industries including wind energy, coatings, electronics, and construction, primarily in North America and Western Europe.

products.name: Sporting and Commercial Ammunition
products.description: Manufacture and sale of small caliber ammunition (shotgun shells, rimfire and centerfire ammunition for pistols and rifles), reloading components, and industrial cartridges under the Winchester brand. Products are produced in large-scale ammunition plants and distributed to commercial retailers, law enforcement, and military customers.

products.name: Military Ammunition and Contracted Project Services
products.description: Production of small caliber military ammunition and provision of engineering and construction services for U.S. Army and allied defense contracts. Manufacturing is performed at government-owned, contractor-operated facilities and includes specialized rounds and facility construction projects.

products.name: Industrial Cartridges and Loads
products.description: Manufacture and sale of industrial cartridges, including 8-gauge loads and powder-actuated tool loads, used in maintenance applications in power and concrete industries and construction. These are produced in ammunition plants and supplied to industrial customers.

products.name: Clay Targets
products.description: Production and sale of clay targets for recreational and competitive shooting, manufactured in specialized facilities and distributed to shooting clubs and retailers.

products.name: Automotive Components and Fasteners
products.description: Manufactured plastic and metal components, fasteners, and assemblies for automobiles and light trucks, delivered to automotive OEMs and tier suppliers through industrial manufacturing processes.

products.name: Commercial Food Equipment and Services
products.description: Manufactures and supplies warewashing, cooking, refrigeration, food processing, and ventilation equipment, as well as providing service, maintenance, and repair for commercial food service, retail, and institutional markets. Products are physically manufactured and delivered, with integrated service offerings.

products.name: Test & Measurement and Electronic Assembly Solutions
products.description: Produces equipment, consumables, and software for testing and measuring materials and structures, as well as equipment and consumables for electronic assembly and contamination control, delivered to industrial and electronics markets via manufacturing and digital solutions.

products.name: Welding Equipment and Consumables
products.description: Manufactures arc welding equipment, consumables, and accessories for industrial and commercial applications, delivered through physical manufacturing and distribution to industrial customers.

products.name: Adhesives, Sealants, Lubricants, and Fluids
products.description: Produces engineered adhesives, sealants, lubrication and cutting fluids, epoxy and resin-based coatings, and related products for industrial, construction, automotive aftermarket, and marine applications, delivered through chemical manufacturing and distribution.

products.name: Construction Fastening Systems and Hardware
products.description: Manufactures fasteners, anchors, fastening tools, truss components, and packaged hardware for wood, metal, and concrete applications in residential and commercial construction, delivered through industrial manufacturing and distribution channels.

products.name: Specialty Packaging, Coding, and Appliance Components
products.description: Produces beverage packaging equipment and consumables, product coding and marking equipment, appliance components, closures, and ground support equipment, delivered to food, beverage, appliance, and industrial markets through specialized manufacturing.

products.name: QRX003 Topical Therapeutic
products.description: A proprietary topical lotion containing a serine protease inhibitor, developed for the treatment of rare genetic skin diseases such as Netherton Syndrome, Peeling Skin Syndrome, Ichthyosis-related disorders, and SAM Syndrome. The product is manufactured using proprietary formulation processes and is intended for chronic, whole-body application, pending regulatory approval.

products.name: QRX008 Small Molecule Therapy
products.description: A small molecule VLA-4 inhibitor in early-stage development for the treatment of scleroderma, a rare autoimmune disease. The product is being developed through a research agreement and may be in-licensed for global commercialization if clinical development is successful.

products.name: Topical Rapamycin Formulations (QRX009 and related)
products.description: Novel topical formulations of rapamycin (sirolimus), including proprietary dissolvable microneedle and dermal patch delivery systems, being developed for the treatment of several rare and orphan diseases such as microcystic lymphatic malformations, venous malformations, angiofibromas, Gorlin Syndrome, Epidermolysis Bullosa, and Pachyonychia Congenita. These are produced via advanced formulation and delivery technologies in partnership with academic institutions.

products.name: Hybrid Fiber-Copper-Coax Networking Solutions
products.description: Hardware and embedded software solutions that enable high-speed, secure, and reliable data and power transmission over a combination of new fiber and existing copper/coax infrastructure. Delivered as compact, cyber-hardened switches, extenders, and aggregators, these solutions are physically manufactured and deployed in wide-area and building networks.

products.name: Cybersecurity and AI-Based Network Protection Software (MetaShield)
products.description: Cloud-based, AI-powered software platform providing continuous cyber monitoring, threat detection, vulnerability scanning, and automated mitigation for IoT and network devices. Delivered as SaaS, either standalone or integrated with Actelis hardware, requiring ongoing software development and cloud infrastructure.

products.name: Network Management Software (EMS)
products.description: Element Management System (EMS) software for remote configuration, monitoring, maintenance, and security management of Actelis network devices. Sold as perpetual or term-based licenses, this digital product enables automated and centralized management of large-scale hybrid networks.

products.name: Support and Maintenance Services
products.description: Fee-based contracts for hardware repair, replacement, technical support, remote diagnostics, on-site assistance, and software updates beyond standard warranty. Delivered by in-person and remote human labor, these services are sold as standalone or bundled contracts with varying service levels.

products.name: Custom Software Development and Feature Enhancements
products.description: Professional services to customize Actelis software and hardware features to meet specific customer requirements, delivered by engineering teams for an additional fee. Involves software development and integration work.

products.name: Cigarettes
products.description: Manufactured combustible tobacco products sold under international and local brands, including Marlboro, Parliament, Chesterfield, L&M, and Philip Morris, distributed in approximately 170 markets through various retail and wholesale channels.

products.name: Heated Tobacco Products (HTUs)
products.description: Manufactured tobacco consumables designed for use with electronic heating devices (e.g., IQOS), which heat tobacco without combustion to generate an aerosol, distributed globally under brands such as HEETS, TEREA, SENTIA, and others.

products.name: Nicotine Pouches and Oral Smokeless Products
products.description: Oral nicotine delivery products, including nicotine pouches (e.g., ZYN), snus, moist snuff, tobacco bits, and chew bags, manufactured and distributed in multiple markets, often as smoke-free alternatives to cigarettes.

products.name: E-vapor Products
products.description: Electronic vapor products (e.g., VEEV) that deliver nicotine via vaporized liquid, manufactured and distributed as smoke-free alternatives to traditional cigarettes, available in various markets.

products.name: Consumer Wellness Products
products.description: Primarily oral consumer wellness offerings, including medical and non-recreational cannabinoid products (such as CBD), developed and commercialized under the Aspeya wellness unit, with a focus on regulatory compliance.

products.name: Consumer Accessories (Lighters, Matches, Devices)
products.description: Consumer accessories such as lighters, matches, and electronic devices (e.g., IQOS devices), manufactured or sourced from third parties and sold alongside tobacco and smoke-free products.

products.name: Streaming Entertainment Service
products.description: A digital subscription service delivering TV series, films, games, and live programming across various genres and languages to members globally via internet streaming. Content is accessed on-demand through a user interface that allows play, pause, and resume functionality on multiple devices.

products.name: Agricultural Equipment
products.description: Develops, manufactures, and sells a full line of agricultural machinery including tractors, harvesters, hay and forage equipment, seeding and planting equipment, and self-propelled sprayers. Delivered through physical manufacturing and global dealer networks, with integration of precision agriculture technologies and digital solutions.

products.name: Precision Agriculture Solutions
products.description: Provides precision agriculture technologies such as guidance, automated steering, application control, GNSS positioning, connectivity, automation, and autonomy. Delivered as integrated features on new equipment and as aftermarket retrofit solutions, requiring advanced digital and hardware development.

products.name: Construction Equipment
products.description: Develops, manufactures, and sells a full line of heavy and light construction equipment including excavators, dozers, graders, wheel loaders, backhoe loaders, skid steer loaders, compact track loaders, and specialized attachments. Delivered through physical manufacturing and global dealer networks, with increasing integration of electric and precision technologies.

products.name: Aftermarket Parts and Services
products.description: Provides proprietary parts, maintenance, repair contracts, warranty extension, and connected support services for agricultural and construction equipment. Delivered through a global network of parts depots and dealer service shops, leveraging digital connectivity and analytics for predictive maintenance.

products.name: Financial Services for Equipment
products.description: Offers retail and wholesale financing, leasing, and revolving credit for the purchase or lease of new and used agricultural and construction equipment, as well as dealer inventory and working capital financing. Delivered through captive finance subsidiaries and joint ventures, requiring financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Precision Technology Components and Solutions (Third-Party Sales)
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and sells precision technology components such as GNSS solutions, machine vision sensors, and autonomous systems to third-party equipment manufacturers and partners. Delivered as standalone products or integrated modules, requiring advanced R&D and digital infrastructure.

products.name: Kraft Pulp (NBSK and NBHK)
products.description: Manufactured at modern pulp mills in Germany and Canada, kraft pulp (primarily northern bleached softwood kraft and some northern bleached hardwood kraft) is produced through a chemical process and sold globally to paper, tissue, and specialty product manufacturers. Production requires large-scale, capital-intensive facilities and regulated processes.

products.name: Lumber Products
products.description: Produced at sawmills in Germany, lumber includes rough green and dry lumber, kiln-dried dimension lumber, and specialty grades for construction and manufacturing markets in Europe, North America, and Asia. Production involves physical manufacturing, sawmilling, and finishing processes.

products.name: Mass Timber Products (CLT, Glulam, Finger Joint Lumber)
products.description: Manufactured at mass timber facilities in North America, these engineered wood products (cross-laminated timber, glue-laminated timber, and finger joint lumber) are produced by adhering or laminating sawn lumber for use in sustainable construction as alternatives to steel and concrete. Production is capital-intensive and highly automated.

products.name: Wood Pallets
products.description: Produced at integrated sawmill facilities, primarily in Germany, wood pallets (including Euro-pallets) are manufactured at scale for shipping and logistics customers. Production involves sawmilling, assembly, and value-added processes.

products.name: Biofuels (Wood Pellets and Briquettes)
products.description: Produced as by-products at sawmills and integrated facilities, biofuels such as wood pellets and briquettes are manufactured from wood residuals and used for energy generation. Production leverages waste streams and specialized pelletizing equipment.

products.name: Surplus Green Electricity
products.description: Generated as a by-product of pulp and sawmill operations using biomass cogeneration, surplus green electricity is sold to regional utilities and markets. Production relies on large-scale, regulated, and capital-intensive cogeneration infrastructure.

products.name: Chemicals (Tall Oil and By-products)
products.description: Produced as by-products of the kraft pulping process, chemicals such as tall oil are extracted and sold for use as chemical additives and green energy sources. Production is integrated into pulp mill operations and involves regulated chemical recovery systems.

products.name: Lignin (Pilot Production)
products.description: Produced at a pilot facility in Germany, lignin is extracted from black liquor as a sustainable, bio-based material with potential applications in green products. Production is currently limited to pilot scale and research.

products.name: Non-Rechargeable Lithium Batteries
products.description: Manufactures and markets a range of non-rechargeable lithium batteries (including 9-volt, cylindrical, thin cell, and specialty form factors) using chemistries such as Lithium Manganese Dioxide, Lithium Manganese Dioxide Carbon Monofluoride hybrid, and Lithium Thionyl Chloride. These are produced in company-owned ISO-certified facilities and sold to OEMs, distributors, and directly to end-users for applications in medical, industrial, defense, oil and gas, and consumer markets.

products.name: Rechargeable Battery Systems
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and markets rechargeable battery systems using Lithium-ion and Nickel Metal Hydride chemistries, including custom battery packs, smart batteries, and battery management systems. These products are produced in global ISO-certified facilities and are used in medical, communications, industrial, and defense applications.

products.name: Battery Charging Systems and Accessories
products.description: Provides a wide range of battery charging systems and accessories, including smart chargers, multi-bay charging systems, cables, and battery management systems. These are manufactured in-house and offered as part of integrated power solutions for military, medical, and industrial customers.

products.name: Integrated Power Solutions and Battery Packs
products.description: Designs and manufactures custom-engineered battery packs and integrated power solutions, including large-format multi-kilowatt modules and specialized packs for demanding applications such as oil and gas, marine, industrial, and medical devices. These are produced to customer specifications and often involve advanced engineering and assembly.

products.name: Military Communications Systems and Accessories
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and integrates communications systems and accessories for military applications, including RF amplifiers, power supplies, cables, connector assemblies, amplified speakers, equipment mounts, man-portable systems, and vehicle-mounted integrated communication systems. These are built to withstand extreme environments and are sold to U.S. and allied militaries and defense contractors.

products.name: Commercial Integrated Communication Systems
products.description: Provides integrated communication systems for commercial customers, combining information technology equipment and power conversion in ruggedized cases for use in industries such as automotive, cellular, and manufacturing. These systems are designed, assembled, and delivered as turnkey solutions.

products.name: Technology Development Contracts
products.description: Undertakes contract-based technology development projects for government agencies and private sector clients, focusing on the advancement of battery and power technologies. These contracts involve R&D, prototyping, and product enhancement, and result in intellectual property and potential commercialization of new products.

products.name: LungFit Platform (including LungFit PH, PRO, and GO)
products.description: A suite of medical devices that generate and deliver nitric oxide (NO) from ambient air for inhalation therapy, used in hospitals and at home. The platform is manufactured at commercial scale and delivers NO at various concentrations for different respiratory conditions, including persistent pulmonary hypertension of the newborn (PPHN), viral and bacterial lung infections, bronchiolitis, and nontuberculous mycobacteria (NTM) lung disease. Delivery is via ventilator, face mask, or similar apparatus, with continuous monitoring and programmable dosing.

products.name: Ultra-High Concentration Nitric Oxide (UNO) Therapy for Solid Tumors
products.description: A proprietary gas-based therapy delivering ultra-high concentrations of nitric oxide (UNO) directly to solid tumors via a specialized delivery system, designed to induce tumor ablation and stimulate immune response. This therapy is being developed and commercialized through the Beyond Cancer affiliate and is currently in clinical trials for various solid tumor indications.

products.name: Neuronal Nitric Oxide Synthase (nNOS) Inhibitors for Neurological Conditions
products.description: A pharmaceutical program developing small molecule inhibitors of neuronal nitric oxide synthase (nNOS) for the treatment of neurological conditions, with an initial focus on autism spectrum disorder (ASD). The program is in preclinical development and is being advanced through the NeuroNOS affiliate.

products.name: INTASYL-based Immuno-Oncology Therapeutics
products.description: Therapeutic drug candidates developed using proprietary INTASYL small interfering RNA (siRNA) technology, designed to silence specific genes in immune and tumor cells to enhance anti-tumor immune responses. These are manufactured via chemical synthesis and delivered as injectable drugs, requiring clinical development and regulatory approval.

products.name: Senior Secured Lending
products.description: Provision of first lien and second lien senior secured loans (including unitranche loans) to primarily U.S. middle-market companies. These loans are originated, structured, and held by the company, often secured by collateral and typically have terms of three to ten years. Delivery requires significant financial capital, credit analysis, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Subordinated Debt and Mezzanine Lending
products.description: Provision of subordinated debt (mezzanine debt), which is typically unsecured or junior to senior loans, to middle-market companies. These investments often include an equity component such as warrants or preferred equity, and are structured to provide fixed returns and potential capital appreciation. Delivery requires financial structuring expertise and capital.

products.name: Preferred and Common Equity Investments
products.description: Equity investments in portfolio companies, including preferred equity (often in conjunction with debt investments) and, to a lesser extent, non-control common equity positions. These investments are typically made alongside debt financings and may provide capital appreciation. Delivery involves financial capital and investment management expertise.

products.name: Asset Management Services (via Ivy Hill Asset Management, L.P.)
products.description: Provision of asset management and investment advisory services to external clients through the wholly owned subsidiary Ivy Hill Asset Management, L.P. (IHAM), which manages investment vehicles and funds. Delivery requires regulatory registration, investment expertise, and operational infrastructure.

products.name: Syndication and Co-Investment of Loans
products.description: Origination and syndication of large loan commitments, including co-investment with affiliated funds and external partners, where the company may lead, underwrite, and subsequently syndicate or sell portions of loans to other investors. Delivery involves capital markets expertise and relationships with institutional investors.

products.name: Hemp-Derived Cannabinoid Wellness Products
products.description: Manufactured and marketed under the cbdMD® brand, these products include oils, gummies, capsules, soft-gels, topicals, and functional formulations containing broad-spectrum and full-spectrum CBD, as well as compliant hemp-derived Delta-9 THC. Products are produced using U.S.-grown hemp, rigorous quality controls, and both in-house and third-party manufacturing.

products.name: Pet Wellness Products
products.description: Sold under the Paw CBD® brand, these products include tinctures, chews, and topicals for dogs and cats, formulated with hemp-derived cannabinoids and produced with a focus on safety and quality for animal health. Manufacturing involves blending, encapsulation, and strict quality controls.

products.name: Functional Mushroom and Nootropic Supplements
products.description: Marketed under the ATRX® platform, these supplements feature functional mushrooms and other non-cannabinoid ingredients designed for performance, cognitive function, and wellness. Products are developed through proprietary formulations and manufactured using GMP-aligned processes.

products.name: Hemp-Derived THC-Infused Functional Beverages
products.description: Sold under the Herbal Oasis (“Oasis”) brand, these ready-to-drink beverages blend hemp-derived THC and nootropic mushrooms to deliver functional effects. Production involves beverage formulation, blending, and packaging, with distribution through beverage and alcohol distributors.

products.name: Direct-to-Consumer Online Retail of Wellness Products
products.description: Through the Direct CBD Online platform, the company sells a curated selection of its own and third-party wellness products directly to consumers via e-commerce, leveraging warehousing, fulfillment, and digital marketing infrastructure.

products.name: Oxybate Therapies for Rare Sleep Disorders
products.description: Oral solutions (Xywav and Xyrem) for the treatment of cataplexy and excessive daytime sleepiness (EDS) in narcolepsy and idiopathic hypersomnia (IH), manufactured in Ireland and by contract manufacturers, distributed via specialty pharmacy under a REMS program.

products.name: Cannabidiol-Based Epilepsy Therapies
products.description: Highly purified, plant-derived cannabidiol (Epidiolex/Epidyolex) oral solutions for the treatment of seizures associated with Lennox-Gastaut syndrome (LGS), Dravet syndrome (DS), and tuberous sclerosis complex (TSC), manufactured in the UK and distributed globally.

products.name: HER2-Directed Oncology Therapies
products.description: Bispecific antibody therapy (Ziihera/zanidatamab-hrii) for HER2-positive biliary tract cancer (BTC), manufactured by contract partners, approved and launched in the US, EU, and Canada for adults with unresectable or metastatic HER2-positive BTC.

products.name: Oncology Therapy for Diffuse Midline Glioma
products.description: Oral therapy (Modeyso/dordaviprone), a protease activator and DRD2 inhibitor, for treatment of diffuse midline glioma with H3 K27M mutation, manufactured by contract partners, approved for pediatric and adult patients following prior therapy.

products.name: Small Cell Lung Cancer Therapies
products.description: Alkylating agent (Zepzelca/lurbinectedin) for metastatic small cell lung cancer (SCLC), administered intravenously, manufactured by contract partners, approved for use as monotherapy and in combination regimens in the US and Canada.

products.name: Recombinant Erwinia Asparaginase Therapies
products.description: Recombinant asparaginase (Rylaze/Enrylaze) for use as part of multi-agent chemotherapy regimens in acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL) or lymphoblastic lymphoma (LBL) patients with hypersensitivity to E. coli-derived asparaginase, manufactured by contract partners and distributed in the US, EU, and other markets.

products.name: Liposomal Chemotherapy for Acute Myeloid Leukemia
products.description: Liposomal formulation (Vyxeos) of daunorubicin and cytarabine for treatment of newly diagnosed therapy-related AML or AML with myelodysplasia-related changes, manufactured using proprietary CombiPlex technology by contract partners.

products.name: Defibrotide Therapy for Veno-Occlusive Disease
products.description: Defibrotide (Defitelio), derived from porcine DNA, for treatment and prevention of hepatic veno-occlusive disease (VOD) following hematopoietic stem cell transplantation, manufactured in-house in Italy and finished by contract partners, distributed globally.

products.name: ONS-5010/LYTENAVA (Ophthalmic Bevacizumab)
products.description: A full-length, humanized anti-VEGF recombinant monoclonal antibody formulated specifically for ophthalmic use, manufactured in the United States under cGMP standards, and delivered via intravitreal injection for the treatment of retinal diseases such as wet age-related macular degeneration (wet AMD), diabetic macular edema (DME), and branch retinal vein occlusion (BRVO). Commercialized in vials and with plans for pre-filled syringes, it is approved in the EU and UK and under regulatory review in the US and other markets.

products.name: AI-Optimized Servers
